narrative_vs_numbers.summary: ICICI Bank demonstrated strong operational consistency across FY26 and early FY27, delivering stable net interest margins near 4.30% in Q3-2026 and 4.36% in Q1-2027 before seeing compression to 4.18% in Q2-2027 due to large-scale FCNR(B) deposit mobilization. Management maintained disciplined balance sheet buffers, preserving ₹1,283 crore in required regulatory agricultural provisions without dipping into contingency reserves.

guided.guidance: Management stated that expectation of NIM is that, in FY27, it should be range-bound assuming no rate movements.
guided.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (23-Jul-2026), PDF p. 5 — "Our expectation of NIM is that, in FY27, it should be range-bound assuming no rate movements."

delivered.actual: The NIM was 4.18% for this quarter compared to 4.36% in the previous quarter.
delivered.source: Q2 FY27 Concall Transcript (23-Oct-2026), PDF p. 5 — "The NIM was 4.18% for this quarter compared to 4.36% in the previous quarter."

quarters.commentary: Net interest margin contracted sequentially to 4.18% from 4.36% in the prior quarter, slipping below the guided range-bound trajectory due to FCNR(B) dilution and retail term deposit repricing.

guided.guidance: Management stated that they expect NIMs to be range-bound in FY27 despite developments in domestic economy, liquidity, and competitive intensity.
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (24-Apr-2026), PDF p. 8 — "including geopolitical developments on the domestic economy, liquidity, deposit rates, and of course, competitive intensity. We do expect NIMs to be range-bound in FY27."

delivered.actual: Net interest margin was 4.36% in Q1-2027 compared to 4.32% in Q4-2026.
delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (23-Jul-2026), PDF p. 3 — "Net interest margin was 4.36% in Q1-2027 compared to 4.32% in Q4-2026"

quarters.commentary: Net interest margin expanded to 4.36% from 4.32% in Q4-2026, beating the range-bound outlook with support from income tax refunds and term deposit repricing.

guided.guidance: Management guided that this additional standard asset provision will continue until the loans are repaid or renewed in conformity with the PSL classification guidelines.
guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (22-Jan-2026), PDF p. 3 — "This additional standard asset provision will continue until the loans are repaid or renewed in conformity with the PSL classification guidelines."

delivered.actual: Management confirmed holding the standard asset provisions which we had made of about ₹1,283 crore, as directed by RBI, on the agri-loan in the last quarter.
delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (24-Apr-2026), PDF p. 12 — "the standard asset provisions which we had made of about ₹1,283 crore, as directed by RBI, on the agri-loan in the last quarter."

quarters.commentary: Management fully preserved the additional standard asset provisions mandated by RBI on the agri-PSL portfolio without any drawdown or utilization.

guided.guidance: Management guided that they expect NIM to remain range bound with some benefit expected around the CRR and repricing of term deposits.
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (24-Oct-2025), PDF p. 8 — "we do expect NIM to remain range bound with some benefit expected around the CRR and repricing of term deposits."

delivered.actual: Net interest margin was 4.30% in Q3-2026 compared to 4.30% in Q2-2026.
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (22-Jan-2026), PDF p. 3 — "Net interest margin was 4.30% in Q3-2026 compared to 4.30% in Q2-2026"

quarters.commentary: Net interest margin held flat sequentially at 4.30%, perfectly matching management's range-bound margin outlook.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management consistently avoids point forecasts in favor of conservative directional guidance (e.g. range-bound margins and risk-calibrated underwriting), meeting or beating asset quality expectations while absorbing macro and regulatory shifts.
